Ward No. 13 Dhaka South City Corporation () is an administrative division of Dhaka South City Corporation Ward, which belongs to Zone-2. It was Ward No. 36 of the former Dhaka City Corporation. Ward No. 13 is located in Shahjahanpur Thana. It forms a city corporation council electoral constituency and is a part of Bangladesh Jatiya Sangsad constituency Dhaka-8.
Overview
Ward No. 13 consists of Chameli Bagh & Amin Bagh, Rajar Bagh Police Line, Purana Paltan GPO, Baitul Mukarram Stadium, Outer Stadium, Vijay Nagar, Nayapaltan, Purana Paltan Line, Traffic Police Barracks, Police Hospital & C&B Ground, Shantinagar, Shantinagar Bazar area of Dhaka city.
